scope: Expanded directory; selected locations, not a complete inventory. Source review is not store confirmation.

walmart.title: Walmart: accessible shopping
walmart.summary: Walmart says all its U.S. stores provide Caroline’s Carts. These listings combine that chain-wide policy with official store contact details; no branch has been called for this edition.

wegmans.title: Utah State University: Caroline’s Cart
wegmans.summary: This 2025 resource names Wegmans among retailers carrying the cart. It does not identify individual branches. The six Wegmans entries are places to ask, not branch confirmations.

bigy.title: I-95: Connecticut cart locations
bigy.summary: A June 2016 local report names five Big Y towns. Current Big Y contact listings identify the branches below. Cart availability needs a fresh check.

wilmington.title: Wilmington Apple: Target cart rollout
wilmington.summary: A February 2016 report specifically includes Wilmington in the planned Target rollout. This is historical evidence, not current cart inventory.

ansonia.title: Lawrence Berliner: Ansonia Target cart report
ansonia.summary: This resource points to April 2016 coverage of a cart at Ansonia Target and the former Caroline’s Cart Connecticut directory. Reconfirmation is needed.

target-chain.title: Target: chain report and rollout context
target-chain.summary: Utah State University names Target as a retailer carrying Caroline’s Cart in April 2025, without identifying branches. Target’s 2016 rollout excluded some small stores. These ten additional locations are call-ahead leads with current store contact details, not confirmed cart locations.
